Drafter-era ledgers are the E4 golden baselines (harness/regression_baselines/*.golden.json, frozen 2026-07-21, preserved byte-for-byte); graph-sourced sections are the current docs/tier5_deliverables/proposal_sections/*.json.
measurement.prose_byte_identity: 12/12 sub-sections byte-identical (per-sub-section content SHA-256 matches the golden). The ledger is the ONLY variable; the cardinality deficit is exact, not confounded by content drift.
measurement.coarse_ledger_shape: Graph claims carry only {claim_id, claim_summary, status}; no per-claim source_ref. The 5/4/3 summaries are the evaluation criterion + its sub-criterion titles. Grounding is declared once at section level in traceability_footer.primary_sources (16 sources for excellence) plus no_unsupported_claims_declaration, with overall_status=inferred. It is a section-level synthesis posture, not a per-assertion attribution.

judge_layer_limitation.not_run: E2 (per-claim faithfulness scoring) and E3 (semantic prose decomposition + coverage matching) — the judge-scored layers — were NOT executed.
judge_layer_limitation.reason: Both require an independent, non-Claude judge endpoint (OpenAI-compatible transport). None is configured under this repo's subscription-only claude_cli transport, and harness/judge.py structurally refuses the drafter's own model for grader-generator independence. Fabricating judge verdicts would violate CLAUDE.md §13 and the harness's own guardrails. This matches the harness's recorded state (e3 decision-log open item: 'A live (non-stub) E3 run over the three sections awaits a configured OpenAI-compatible judge endpoint').
judge_layer_limitation.why_deterministic_evidence_is_sufficient: The prose is byte-identical, so E3's decomposition would yield the SAME material-assertion set for both variants — the completeness denominator is held constant. Only the ledger (numerator of attribution) differs. A single node-level record per multi-paragraph sub-section cannot atomically attribute the dozens of assertions the ~34-record drafter ledger attributes; the measured 33.8x cardinality deficit over identical prose is therefore a firm lower bound on the judge-scored escaped-material-assertion gap. The status axis is fully deterministic and judge-independent: graph = 0 confirmed claims, drafter = 359 confirmed claims.

decision: ACCEPT COARSE (measured). The provisional acceptance of the graph compiler's ~1-per-sub-section node-level claim ledger is confirmed as a recorded decision. The compiler's ledger derivation is NOT enriched; no enrichment follow-up ticket is filed. A re-open trigger is recorded (below).
decision_rationale: Zero evaluator-facing regression: the prose is byte-identical across all 12 sub-sections (verified by content SHA-256 vs the E4 goldens). The document an evaluator reads is unchanged; only the machine-readable claim ledger differs.

Status honesty favors the coarse ledger: the graph ledger makes 0 'confirmed' claims — every claim is 'inferred' (synthesis over confirmed facts, per the compiler's status-preserving rule) with section-level provenance. The drafter ledger stamped 359 claims 'confirmed'. E2 exists precisely because a deterministic predicate can see only that a source_ref field is non-blank, never whether the source supports the sentence — so the drafter's 359 confirmed stamps are 359 unverifiable 'gap-masked-as-confirmed' integrity risks, while the coarse ledger asserts none it cannot back. Coarse-but-honest > granular-but-overclaimed.

Determinism / replayability: the graph ledger is deterministically derived from the vault (byte-equal replayable), aligning with the repo's core anti-fabrication guarantee (§17.5.3). The 406-entry drafter ledger is a non-replayable stochastic LLM artifact.

The §10.5 escaped-claim risk is bounded here: §10.5 targets unattributed *confirmed* assertions. A section that declares itself overall_status=inferred synthesis with a section-level traceability_footer is not asserting unattributed confirmed facts. Enriching would either keep every derived sub-claim 'inferred' (finer audit trail but same evidential status — modest gain for real derivation complexity) or re-introduce per-claim 'confirmed' stamps the deterministic compiler cannot justify without a judge — re-opening the exact integrity hole the graph design closed.
re_open_trigger: Revisit this acceptance if, once an independent (non-Claude) judge endpoint is configured (e.g. after harness E5), a full judge-scored E2/E3 run over these three sections shows an escaped-material-assertion rate above an operator-set bar, OR if a downstream evaluator/audit requirement demands per-assertion (not section-level) claim traceability. Until such evidence exists, the coarse ledger stands as accepted, not provisional.
